title: Pirate's Smile | Real Joy
meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home! *  Just 630 Steps to the Private Beach Access* 4 Bikes Included* 5 Unique Porches* Huge Community Pool * Outdoor Shower* FREE Seasonal Tram Service to the Beach and Pool * Walk to Rosemary Beach and Alys
description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home! * Just 630 Steps to the Private Beach Access* 4 Bikes Included* 5 Unique Porches* Huge Community Pool * Outdoor Shower* FREE Seasonal Tram Service to the Beach and Pool * Walk to Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach! * Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service *This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions. **Parking passes will be provided equally to the number of bedrooms in the home. Not all parking spots are located directly by the home. Additional passes may be purchased for $50 each. Wristbands are required for use of the Seacrest Beach amenities and are limited to the maximum occupancy of the home. *Welcome to Pirate’s Smile this home delivers the perfect mix of coastal luxury, comfort, and fun just steps from the beach. Set on a spacious corner lot near Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach, this beautifully appointed home offers ample parking, five porches, a private outdoor shower, and easy access to the community pool and tram. Inside, relax in the spacious living room with a 75” 4K TV, premium channels, high-speed Wi-Fi, and a dedicated workspace. The gourmet kitchen features Turkish marble countertops, high-end appliances, and seating for 11—perfect for gathering over meals. The back deck is made for vacation mode, with a summer kitchen, gas grill, comfortable seating, and 58” 4K TV for outdoor entertaining. Four beautifully designed bedrooms offer king beds, premium mattresses, private or shared baths, and 4K TVs. The Captain’s Quarters stands out with a soaking tub and private veranda, while the kids will love Buccaneers’ Bunks with custom bunk beds, charging stations, and their own entertainment setup. A queen sleeper sofa in the Crow’s Nest provides additional sleeping space. With the beach across the street, a 12,000-square-foot lagoon pool, seasonal poolside dining, and 30A’s best attractions nearby, Pirate’s Smile makes it easy to settle in, slow down, and enjoy the coast.The Bed Setup:1st FloorGuest Bedroom 1: King Bed2nd FloorMaster Bedroom: King Bed Guest Bedroom 2: King BedGuest Bedroom 3: 2 Twin Bunk BedsCrow’s Nest: 2 Sleeper SofasSeacrest Beach Community is perfectly nestled between Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach on Hwy 30A. This luxury development offers an array of amenities including deeded beach access just across the street, a huge 12,000sqft community lagoon pool, an amphitheater, seasonal tram service to the beach or pool, and 1.35 miles of walking trails! The convenient location is within walking distance to world-class dining, spas, wine bars, and many wonderful locally owned shops! Come see why friends and families vacation at Seacrest Beach year after year!Area Attractions:Rosemary Beach is only minutes away, with shops and restaurants, including the Old World-style town center with a coffee shop, bike and surf rentals, and unique shops. Check out the open-air markets on the weekends. Enjoy the beautiful sugar-white sand beaches that made 30A world famous. Enjoy walking and biking everywhere around Rosemary, Seacrest, and Alys. Don't miss the newly opened 30Avenue for even more dining and shopping options. 30Avenue is just north of Rosemary across Hwy 98, near both Shades Sports Bar and The Donut Hole.This laid-back, fun family atmosphere awaits you! Come stay and play and see for yourself what makes our community and the 30A area so special!The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
